(api_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or api_path like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
and request_status =#{result}
and app_name like concat('%',#{appName},'%')
and request_time >=CAST(#{startTime} AS DATETIME) and request_time <=CAST(#{endTime} AS DATETIME)
and request_time >=CAST(#{startTime} AS TIMESTAMP) and request_time <=CAST(#{endTime} AS TIMESTAMP)
order by log_id desc

SELECT log_id, api_id, api_name, api_path, api_method, auth_type, app_name, request_ip, query_param, request_body, response_body, body_size, request_status, request_time, response_time, cost_time, response_code FROM base_api_log where log_id =#{logId}
mapper.insert: insert into base_api_log( api_id, api_name, api_path, api_method, app_name, auth_type, request_ip, query_param, request_body, response_body, body_size, request_status, response_code, cost_time,request_time,response_time )values( #{apiId}, #{apiName}, #{apiPath}, #{apiMethod}, #{appName}, #{authType}, #{requestIp}, #{queryParam}, #{requestBody}, #{responseBody}, #{bodySize}, #{requestStatus}, #{responseCode}, #{costTime},#{requestTime},#{responseTime} )

insert into base_api_log( api_id, api_name, api_path, api_method, app_name, auth_type, request_ip, query_param, request_body, response_body, body_size, request_status, response_code, cost_time, request_time, response_time )values
( #{item.apiId}, #{item.apiName}, #{item.apiPath}, #{item.apiMethod}, #{item.appName}, #{item.authType}, #{item.requestIp}, #{item.queryParam}, #{item.requestBody}, #{item.responseBody}, #{item.bodySize}, #{item.requestStatus}, #{item.responseCode}, #{item.costTime}, #{item.requestTime}, #{item.responseTime} )

where.if: (api_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or api_path like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))

if.test: startTime !=null and startTime !='' and endTime !=null and endTime !=''

choose.when: and request_time >=CAST(#{startTime} AS DATETIME) and request_time <=CAST(#{endTime} AS DATETIME)
choose.otherwise: and request_time >=CAST(#{startTime} AS TIMESTAMP) and request_time <=CAST(#{endTime} AS TIMESTAMP)

mapper.select: SELECT count(1) AS totalCount, sum(case when request_status = 'success' then 1 else 0 end) AS successCount, sum(case when request_status = 'fail' then 1 else 0 end) AS failCount, avg(COALESCE(cost_time, 0)) AS avgCostTime, max(COALESCE(cost_time, 0)) AS maxCostTime FROM base_api_log

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(request_time,'%Y-%m-%d') AS statisticDate, count(1) AS totalCount, sum(case when request_status = 'success' then 1 else 0 end) AS successCount, sum(case when request_status = 'fail' then 1 else 0 end) AS failCount, avg(COALESCE(cost_time, 0)) AS avgCostTime FROM base_api_log
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(request_time,'%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY statisticDate ASC

SELECT TO_CHAR(request_time,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS statisticDate, count(1) AS totalCount, sum(case when request_status = 'success' then 1 else 0 end) AS successCount, sum(case when request_status = 'fail' then 1 else 0 end) AS failCount, avg(COALESCE(cost_time, 0)) AS avgCostTime FROM base_api_log
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(request_time,'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY statisticDate ASC

SELECT COALESCE(request_status, 'unknown') AS groupKey, COALESCE(request_status, 'unknown') AS groupName, count(1) AS count FROM base_api_log
GROUP BY COALESCE(request_status, 'unknown') ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT ifnull(cast(api_id as char), api_path) AS groupKey, ifnull(api_name, api_path) AS groupName, api_path AS apiPath, count(1) AS count FROM base_api_log
GROUP BY api_id, api_name, api_path ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COALESCE(CAST(api_id AS VARCHAR), api_path) AS groupKey, COALESCE(api_name, api_path) AS groupName, api_path AS apiPath, count(1) AS count FROM base_api_log
GROUP BY api_id, api_name, api_path ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT ifnull(cast(api_id as char), api_path) AS groupKey, ifnull(api_name, api_path) AS groupName, api_path AS apiPath, count(1) AS count, avg(ifnull(cost_time, 0)) AS avgCostTime, max(ifnull(cost_time, 0)) AS maxCostTime FROM base_api_log
GROUP BY api_id, api_name, api_path ORDER BY avgCostTime DESC, maxCostTime DESC, count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COALESCE(CAST(api_id AS VARCHAR), api_path) AS groupKey, COALESCE(api_name, api_path) AS groupName, api_path AS apiPath, count(1) AS count, avg(COALESCE(cost_time, 0)) AS avgCostTime, max(COALESCE(cost_time, 0)) AS maxCostTime FROM base_api_log
GROUP BY api_id, api_name, api_path ORDER BY avgCostTime DESC, maxCostTime DESC, count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COALESCE(request_ip, 'unknown') AS groupKey, COALESCE(request_ip, 'unknown') AS groupName, count(1) AS count FROM base_api_log
GROUP BY COALESCE(request_ip, 'unknown') ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10
mapper.delete: DELETE t FROM base_api_log t INNER JOIN ( SELECT log_id FROM base_api_log WHERE request_time <= CAST(#{endTime} AS DATETIME) ORDER BY log_id LIMIT #{limit} ) s ON t.log_id = s.log_id
DELETE FROM base_api_log WHERE log_id IN ( SELECT log_id FROM base_api_log WHERE request_time <= CAST(#{endTime} AS TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY log_id LIMIT #{limit} )
